name: Anomalie Anormal
description: Rupture dimensionnelle ouvrant des portes entre les réalités parallèles permettant des manoeuvres tactiques impossibles autrement.

subject.archetype: Anomalie Anormal — Incursion Dissonante Uncommon furtif

loadout.armor_outfit: Formes instables entre plusieurs réalités. Membres se dupliquant en images fantômes. Couleurs impossibles. Texture glitch comme un fichier corrompu.
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's heal ability (all_own) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Ready stance suggesting trained competence — character poised and alert with professional confidence — Expanding healing wave reaching every allied position simultaneously

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Void Black
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — gaps where reality is missing

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Directional light from above-right creating defined highlights on key equipment details

camera.angle: slightly low angle conveying growing authority and competence

scenography.setting: Space where multiple realities overlap, buildings from different dimensions coexisting, sky showing conflicting celestial bodies and impossible colors
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Chromatic aberration splitting colors, spatial tears showing parallel dimensions, partial phasing between states, glitch artifacts and digital corruption, plus aura heal — expanding ring of golden light passing through all friendly units visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Rupture dimensionnelle ouvrant des portes entre les réalités parallèles permettant des manoeuvres tactiques impossibles autrement.
card_metadata.faction_lore: L'Incursion Dissonante est l'ouverture de fissures entre les réalités, laissant passer des entités impossibles. Leur présence corrompt la structure même du réel.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Oxidized copper frame with basic faction markings on each corner, slightly weathered patina
card_metadata.composition_directive: Three-quarter portrait showing upper body and primary equipment/weapon clearly visible
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
